titulo: A água vira vinho em Caná

cenas.trecho: Um casamento em Caná da Galileia. A festa durava dias, mas o vinho acabou.
cenas.prompt_imagem: close-up of a festive wooden table at night in first century Judea, empty clay cups and a tipped-over empty clay wine jar, oil lamps and flowers, nobody at the table
cenas.prompt_movimento: the lamp flames flicker softly and the light dances on the empty cups, static camera

cenas.trecho: Naquela época, isso era uma vergonha enorme para os noivos.
cenas.prompt_imagem: dark silhouettes of a young bride and groom seen from behind standing in a stone doorway at night, lit by a single oil lamp, festive courtyard far behind them, faces not visible
cenas.prompt_movimento: the lamp flame flickers and the light trembles on the stone walls, the couple stays completely still, slow camera push-in

cenas.trecho: Maria percebeu e disse aos servos: Façam tudo o que ele mandar.
cenas.prompt_imagem: silhouette of a woman with a long head covering seen from behind in a stone courtyard at night, two servant silhouettes in front of her far away, oil lamps, faces not visible
cenas.prompt_movimento: her head covering moves gently in the breeze, lamp light flickers, everyone stays still, static camera

cenas.trecho: Ali havia seis enormes potes de pedra. Jesus mandou enchê-los de água.
cenas.prompt_imagem: six large stone water jars standing in a row in a stone courtyard at night, oil lamp light, olive branches, no people
cenas.prompt_movimento: lamp light flickers over the stone jars, a few moths fly near the lamp, slow camera pan along the jars

cenas.trecho: E os servos encheram até a borda.
cenas.prompt_imagem: close-up of a servant's hands and arms pouring water from a clay pitcher into a large stone jar filled to the brim, oil lamp light, no faces
cenas.prompt_movimento: water flows from the clay pitcher into the stone jar with gentle splashes and ripples, slow camera push-in

cenas.trecho: O mestre da festa provou e se espantou: o melhor vinho ficou para o fim.
cenas.prompt_imagem: close-up of a large stone jar filled to the brim with deep red wine glowing in warm lamp light, a simple clay cup dipping into it, first century, no glass
cenas.prompt_movimento: the surface of the red wine ripples gently and shimmers in the lamp light, slow camera push-in

cenas.trecho: Foi o primeiro milagre de Jesus. João, capítulo dois.
cenas.prompt_imagem: a bearded man with long brown hair in a white robe seen from behind, small in the frame, standing under a stone archway looking at a festive village courtyard at night with lanterns, faces not visible
cenas.prompt_movimento: lanterns glow and sway gently, his robe moves slightly in the breeze, he stays completely still facing away, slow camera push-in

cenas.trecho: Se ele cuidou de uma festa, imagine da sua vida. Siga para ver o próximo.
cenas.prompt_imagem: wide view of a first century village courtyard at night with hanging oil lanterns and olive trees, tiny distant dark silhouettes of people celebrating, starry sky, warm golden glow
cenas.prompt_movimento: lanterns sway gently in the breeze, stars twinkle, olive leaves move softly, slow camera pull-back
